'''Brady Drezwicki''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Green Bay tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with Light sealed deck (Mon Mothma, Ewoks, Nebulon-B frigate, X-wing), according to Matt Woleske's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1518">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00d1518/ d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00], DeckTech (Matt "Ooryl_909" Woleske, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-d-ii-endor-sealed-gb-12-9-00d1518/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
